---
title: "Render and emit the Manual"
engine: markdown
---

The Manual follows the same authoring and emit profiles as the Madagascar
Healthshed Clinic Data Manual. Its emitted application is the `depot` Python
library in `src/depot`, together with this render helper. Catalogue metadata
and resource records are pandas DataFrames rendered directly with Great Tables.
Neither profile executes the library or opens released data.

::: {.manual-prereq}

Run from the repository root with Bash, rsync, Python 3, and Quarto 1.9+ on
`PATH`. All Quarto source, profiles, extensions, and project caches live in
`notebooks/`. The same project renders the catalogue landing page, generated
dataset pages, and operating Manual into `docs/`. Run one publishing render
per checkout at a time because promotion replaces the rendered `docs/` tree.

:::

## Render documentation or synchronize generated files

::: {.manual-procedure}

```sh
scripts/render-isolated --profile authoring
scripts/render-isolated --profile emit
```

Run `depot --config CONFIG catalog build` before rendering to refresh public
metadata from verified receipts. Rendering itself uses that saved snapshot and
does not open private operational state. `notebooks/index.qmd` and the generated
`datasets/` pages belong to catalogue generation; authored Manual pages such as
`overview.qmd` are preserved.

The default `authoring` profile renders the site and sets `QUARTO_EMIT=0`.
The helper clears any inherited `QUARTO_EMIT` before Quarto loads the selected
profile, because existing shell variables take precedence over profile environment
files. The explicit `emit` profile sets `QUARTO_EMIT=1` and synchronizes generated files
from the reviewed procedure blocks. Both use the shared
`GoldenPlanetaryHealthLab/quarto-manual-html` format with computation disabled.

The helper stages only public catalogue snapshots, Manual, and software sources. It excludes Quarto caches,
rendered sidecars, and notebook checkpoints; operational configuration, registry,
data, state, staging, workspace, and publication storage are never staged.
Files and documentation are promoted only after Quarto finishes successfully.

:::

## Isolated render helper

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-script-sh file="{{ emit.project_root }}/scripts/render-isolated" mode="0755"}

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

script_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
project_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "${script_dir}/.." && pwd)
stage_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/depot-manual.XXXXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$stage_dir"' EXIT
stage_project="$stage_dir/project"

export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$stage_dir/xdg-cache"
export XDG_DATA_HOME="$stage_dir/xdg-data"
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$stage_dir/xdg-runtime"
mkdir -p "$stage_project" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME" "$XDG_DATA_HOME" "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"

# Copy only documentation and software, never operational data or configuration.
for directory in notebooks src scripts examples tests; do
  rsync -a \
    --exclude '.quarto' \
    --exclude 'site_libs' \
    --exclude '*_files' \
    --exclude '*.html' \
    --exclude '.ipynb_checkpoints' \
    --exclude '__pycache__' \
    "$project_dir/$directory" "$stage_project/"
done
cp "$project_dir/README.md" "$stage_project/README.md"

(
  cd "$stage_project"
  # Quarto profile environment files do not override inherited shell variables.
  unset QUARTO_EMIT
  quarto render notebooks "$@"
)

emit_manifest="$stage_project/notebooks/.quarto/quarto-emit-manifest.tsv"
if [[ -f "$emit_manifest" ]]; then
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r emitted_path source_page; do
    [[ -n "$emitted_path" && -n "$source_page" ]] || continue
    source_file=$(realpath -e "$stage_project/notebooks/$source_page")
    case "$source_file" in
      "$stage_project"/notebooks/*.qmd) ;;
      *) echo "Refusing emit source outside notebooks: $source_page" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    staged_file=$(realpath -e "$stage_project/notebooks/$emitted_path")
    case "$staged_file" in
      "$stage_project"/src/depot/*|"$stage_project"/scripts/render-isolated) ;;
      *) echo "Refusing unexpected emit target: $staged_file" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    destination="$project_dir/${staged_file#"$stage_project"/}"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$destination")"
    # Generated headers use source basenames, so no temporary paths need rebasing.
    rsync -a "$staged_file" "$destination"
  done < "$emit_manifest"
fi

rsync -a --delete "$stage_project/docs/" "$project_dir/docs/"
```

:::

::: {.manual-check}

After authoring, open `docs/index.html` for the catalogue and
`docs/overview.html` for the Operator Manual. Confirm the Python source is
unchanged. After emission, review the generated diff and verify source agreement:

```sh
bash -n scripts/render-isolated
uv run --locked pytest -q tests/test_emission.py
git diff --check
```

The reference Manual uses the same profile and isolation model to emit an R
targets pipeline. This Manual emits Python source; scientific execution and
publication happen only through explicit Depot commands.

:::
